Short verbatim excerpt:
"OPEN"
"Let h(N) be the smallest k such that {1,...,N} can be coloured with k colours"

Context (paraphrase): the colouring must give at least three distinct colours
to every four-term arithmetic progression. The maintained page records the
upper exponent log(3)/log(22) and lower logarithmic exponent 1/9. It also says
that a finite computation cannot resolve the open problem.
